questions.question: Define Cloud Computing and state NIST essential characteristics.
What is the primary difference between horizontal and vertical elasticity?
Identify two distinct advantages of Type-1 bare metal hypervisors over Type-2 hosted hypervisors.
Define the PACELC theorem and explain how it extends the CAP theorem.
State the formula for calculating cloud resource availability across two redundant availability zones.
Explain the architectural differences between Google File System (GFS) and Apache Hadoop HDFS.
List four core features of container runtime specifications under OCI standards.
Define MapReduce split and explain how speculative execution mitigates straggler tasks.
State the CAP theorem trade-off adopted by Apache Cassandra versus Apache HBase.
What is the purpose of a sidecar proxy pattern in a microservices service mesh?
Calculate the effective network throughput and round-trip delay for a 10 Gbps interconnect transferring a 500 MB dataset across two datacenters with 5 ms propagation delay.
Apply consistent hashing with virtual nodes to distribute 10,000 keys across 4 physical servers and compute the redistribution overhead when one server fails.
Analyze the consensus safety and liveness guarantees of the Raft protocol during a network partition scenario.
Deconstruct the CPU scheduling mechanics and memory ballooning techniques employed by Xen hypervisor under high memory pressure.
Evaluate the financial and architectural trade-offs of migrating an on-premise transactional monolith to serverless AWS Lambda versus Google Cloud Run.
Critique the zero-trust security perimeter architecture against traditional VPN-based bastion host architecture for cloud deployments.
Design an automated, multi-region disaster recovery pipeline achieving RPO under 1 minute and RTO under 5 minutes for a critical banking ledger.
Define the Document Object Model (DOM) and describe how event bubbling works in modern JavaScript.
Differentiate between WebSockets and HTTP/2 Server-Sent Events (SSE) with respect to full-duplex communication.
Explain how JSON Web Tokens (JWT) maintain stateless authentication and describe the structure of its three segments.
Demonstrate with code how to implement an asynchronous debouncing decorator in TypeScript to throttle high-frequency search input events.
Implement an ACID-compliant transaction using MongoDB multi-document transactions in Python.
Analyze Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) and Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) attack vectors, comparing their exploitation mechanisms and modern Content Security Policy defenses.
Deconstruct the Virtual DOM reconciliation algorithm in React, detailing its heuristic assumptions and key prop optimization.
Evaluate relational schema normal forms (3NF vs BCNF) versus Denormalized Document stores for an ultra-high concurrency ecommerce platform.
Design a resilient micro-frontend architecture with dynamic federated modules, isolated styling, and centralized authentication state management.
